title: Firebase realtime dashboard adapter
summary: Optional realtime team dashboard adapter that mirrors DontPanic state projection into Firebase and routes dashboard mutations through DontPanic MCP.

auth: gcloud application-default credentials or service account for deploy
config: Firebase web app config for dashboard

verify.readiness: Core/static dashboard does not require Firebase. This adapter is ready only when Firebase project, auth, rules/functions deploy access, and local MCP mutation path are configured.

adapter: Cloud Functions that call DontPanic MCP

mutation_boundary.allowed_path: Dashboard action -> Cloud Function -> DontPanic MCP mutating tool with confirm=true. Firestore mirrors projection state and is not the source of truth.
forbidden: Browser writes that directly mutate plan/gate/signoff state
Cloud Functions writing DontPanic local state without MCP
Making Firebase a requirement for core onboarding

notes: Static dashboard is core and has no Firebase dependency.
Firebase Hosting may host static files, but Firebase realtime behavior is an optional adapter.
